subject: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Jordan / Lena —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed POC kickoff so everyone has the same expectations. Please reply with confirmations/edits and any additional stakeholders we should loop in.

What we heard (pain / goals)
- Pain: inconsistent response quality from current internal search and summarization pipeline; latency spikes under burst traffic.
- Impact: support and sales agents are seeing poor precision on top-3 results and delayed replies during peak hours, increasing handle time and ticket backlog.
- Goal: reduce average response latency from ~1.2s/token to <=0.7s/token in production for the targeted routes; improve top-3 precision for entity extraction tasks by >=10% on our eval set.

Proposed POC / scope (30 days)
- Scope: evaluate Redwood hosted inference with dedicated routing for two routes: (1) short-form customer response generation (max 512 tokens), (2) entity extraction + reranking (structured output).
- Success metrics: latency (p50/p95), unit cost per 1k tokens, top-3 precision on seeded eval prompts, and qualitative pass/fail on 5 sample production prompts.
- Deliverables: POC SOW, prompt/eval set, implementation steps for test traffic, weekly status updates, final performance report.

Owners
- Acme: Jordan Smith (project sponsor), Lena Ortiz (engineering lead)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, POC owner), Aditya Rao (SE, integration & perf), Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Engineer - observability & billing)

Timeline (proposal)
- Week 0 (this week): sign SOW, share access details and test data/seed prompts
- Week 1: environment setup, access verification, sample ingest, baseline run
- Week 2: tuning (batching, quantization profile), KV/prefix caching config, run evals
- Week 3: stress tests & cost analysis, iterate on prompts; prepare final report
- Week 4: findings review, next-step recommendation (deploy/dedicated/reserved capacity)

Access/setup items we need from Acme
1) Temporary test service account with scoped S3 access (read for seed prompts and write for logs) or a secure upload link
2) Sample prompt set (CSV/JSON) and expected label file for evals
3) Network allowlist (if you want to restrict to specific IP ranges)
4) Security contact for questionnaire / SOC2 evidence: we'll share the Redwood packet for review

Attachments: I attached a short SOW and our POC KPI template for your review.

Next steps
- Jordan/Lena: Confirm SOW + access items and preferred start date. If procurement needs the SOW in DocuSign, we can send today.
- Redwood: We'll schedule the kickoff call once access is confirmed and pre-fill the eval prompt sheet.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. A couple quick things:
- Timeline: next Monday (4/5) would be ideal for us to kick off, assuming procurement signs the SOW this week.
- Security: our InfoSec will need the SOC2 artifacts and a short network diagram. Can you send the security packet to security@acme.com?
- Test data: we can provide a small sample prompt set (50 prompts) and labels by Friday.

On procurement, they'll want the SOW via DocuSign and a PO if we move to an ordered pilot. Please include estimated monthly cost ranges in the SOW (even ballpark) so procurement has context.

Jordan

jordan.smith@acme.com | 212-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps

Appreciate the quick reply, Jordan — confirmed on all points. Action items below and clarifications so procurement has what they need.

Action items (Redwood)
- I'll send the SOW via DocuSign today with an estimated pilot spend range (low/expected/high) for procurement. Attachment: POC_SOW_Acme.pdf
- Aditya will send the quick integration checklist and an example IAM policy for the test service account.
- Rishi will scope observability dashboards and provide an example cost/latency dashboard for your finance team.

Action items (Acme)
- Jordan/Lena: share security contact (we'll send packet to security@acme.com unless you specify otherwise) and the sample prompt/label set by Friday.
- Provide an allowlist (if required) and decision on S3 vs secure upload.

Pilot evaluation & prompts
- Prompt set: please include a mix of 50 seed prompts covering short replies (customer support), 20 structured extraction prompts for entity capture, and 10 adversarial examples you care about. We'll use this for initial quality evaluation.
- Evals: we'll run automated precision/recall on the labeled set and do a small human review panel for the 10 adversarial cases.
- Baseline: we'll capture your current baseline numbers during Week 1 so improvements are measured against your production outputs.

Logistics & kickoff
- Proposed kickoff call: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 — 10:00 AM PT (30-45 min)
- Required attendees: Jordan, Lena, Acme security contact, Aditya (Redwood SE), Rishi (Redwood solutions)

Attachments included: POC_SOW_Acme.pdf, redwood-poc-kpi-template.xlsx

If that all looks good, I'll send the DocuSign SOW this afternoon.

Cheers,
Marissa
